rule: Iowa's state races on the November 3, 2026 ballot, keyed by the race ids in ballot_local_2026.sqlite, by the same rule as the Congress pages (ballot/polls/polls_2026.json). Polls only from pollsters in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative (John, 2026-09-29): the latest from up to five of them, and our own average of the ten most recent, the arithmetic shown. Each poll's figures are checked against the pollster's own release; a list of polls (Wikipedia's, labelled as secondary) is used only to find them and to count the polls left out.

polls.note: The question named the two candidates for governor, not their running mates. Marist's release page gives the two figures; the rest is what is left of 100.

The New York Times/Siena poll (June 15-27, 2026) is by a member but its release is behind a paywall, so it is named as pending and not counted.

left_out.note: No pollster in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative has published a poll of this race. Marist's September survey and Emerson's August and September surveys of Iowa did not ask it.

polls.note: A poll paid for by one of the two campaigns, published as the pollster's memo. These are the figures from the first time the question was asked; the memo says 18% had not made up their mind. The poll asked again after reading voters a message in favour of Peterman (Peterman 46, Pate 40); that second figure is not used.

left_out.note: Change Research's poll for the Peterman campaign is the only published poll of this race. Marist's September survey and Emerson's August and September surveys of Iowa did not ask it.

polls.note: A poll paid for by one of the two campaigns. These are the figures from the first time the question was asked, before voters were told anything about the candidates; the memo says 16% were not sure. The poll asked again after voters read a summary of each candidate (Jones 46, Naig 40); that second figure is not used. The pollster's memo is dated August 5, 2026 and was read in the copy the news site Bleeding Heartland keeps; Change Research's own site was not found to carry it.
